text:
Ivy (PeopleOps): Dropping a compact 'leave-aware OKR' + confidence-tag template for managers. Goal: make handoffs resilient when owners have planned time off. Quick review?

Marco (Eng Manager): love it. can we add a short confidence tag (Low/Med/High) with rationale? helps calibration.

Ivy (PeopleOps): yes 12 added 'Confidence: High/Med/Low + 1-line rationale' and 'Backup owner' fields. sample: 

```
Goal (1-line): Shrink model-serving cost per 1M tokens by 12%
Why: reduce infra spend while preserving p95 latency
Primary metric: cost_per_1M_tokens <= $X (monthly average)
Confidence: Med 12 relies on pending quantization experiment
Owner: Sana (primary) / Marco (backup)
Estimated weekly focus: 15-25%
Planned absences: Sana OOO Aug 10-21 (backup covers code review + canary)
Hiring/Onboard deps: none
Risks: quantization regressions; autoscaler perf
```

Sana (IC): can 'Planned absences' be auto-populated from payroll calendar? reduces friction.

Ivy (PeopleOps): yes we'll surface calendar data where possible; added a short blurb managers can paste into invites: 'If you're OOO during delivery windows, list backup and blocking tasks here.'

Tom (Recruiting): useful for hiring ops too 12 added a field 'Interview decider required by' for goals tied to ramping hires. e.g., need X hire by quarter mid-point to reach goal.

Ivy (PeopleOps): nice catch. added 'Hiring signal' line for hiring ops coordination.

HRBot: Resource update queued; templates sync to Knowledge Hub in 24h.

Marco (Eng Manager): OK, I'm going to try this at our next 1:1 and use the confidence tag for team calibration. can you drop the paste-ready TL;DR?

Ivy (PeopleOps): TL;DR paste block included. uploading files to #docs and tagging managers in 2h. thanks for the quick feedback. :thumbsup:
